Draft an architecture decision record for this new requirement on Online Boutique:

**${input:requirement:Paste the requirement here}**

Use [the ADR template](../../docs/adr/template.md) and keep every heading. Set status to **"Proposed"** and number it 0002.

- If something you need is not given (a number, a constraint, a team skill), don't invent it. Write it under **Open questions** at the end.
